---
title: "Model overview"
format: html
---

STBLR fits traits independently. Current public MTBLR jointly models a modest
trait set from complete common-sample packed-BED data or declared independent
summary providers.

| Analysis | Data level | Currently supported public models |
|---|---|---|
| STBLR | Individual packed BED | `bayesc`, `bayesr` |
| STBLR | Summary statistics | `sbayesc`, `sbayesr`, and supported annotation-informed variants |
| MTBLR | Individual packed BED | corrected Cheng MT-BayesC-Pi (`bayesc`) or factorized pattern-by-scale MT-BayesR (`bayesr`) |
| MTBLR | Independent summary statistics | the same two MT priors with CSR or block-eigen operators and fixed provider residual scales |

The `s` prefix means summary statistics, not MAF scaling. Optional
`maf_effect_s` controls MAF-dependent effect-variance scaling independently.

Public fitters are `stblr_csr()`, `stblr_csr_annot()`,
`stblr_block_eigen()`, `stblr_bed()`, `mtblr_bed()`, `mtblr_csr()`, and
`mtblr_block_eigen()`. Overlap-aware MT summary likelihoods remain deferred.

See the [single-trait](single_trait_models.qmd) and
[multi-trait](multi_trait_models.qmd) practical pages, or the
[Methods index](../methods/index.qmd) for likelihood and prior definitions.

## Prior variance calibration

Across these model families, `h2` is the requested initial expected genetic
variance fraction after resolving the model's inclusion or joint-state
probabilities, BayesR component multipliers, fixed or initial sampled MAF-S
marker scales, and annotation/group variance multipliers. Initial probability
weights and Beta/Dirichlet prior-mean weights are kept distinct. For learned
BayesRC annotation coefficients, the inverse-chi-square scale uses the explicitly
recorded resolved-initial-probability policy because no exact closed-form prior
expectation over the coefficients is available.

Public MTBLR routes require an explicit initial $V_b$ and inverse-Wishart
degrees-of-freedom/scale prior. The BED route additionally uses fixed or
sampled full $V_e$; independent-summary routes instead use fixed positive
provider residual scales. Scalar ST variance priors are not recycled into
matrix priors.
